input.summary: Add services warranty, express warranty remedy (repair/replace/refund), compliance with laws and no malicious code to Section 12
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 12 gives us a twelve-month conformance warranty but no stated remedy and no warranty covering Garman's services, legal compliance or malicious code. We have added a professional and workmanlike standard for the Services, a repair/replace/refund remedy for breach, and standard compliance-with-laws and no-malicious-code warranties, consistent with our playbook position.

ops.text: Garman further warrants that: (a) all Services (including installation, data conversion, training and Maintenance Services) will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards, and for a period of ninety (90) days following performance will conform in all material respects to the applicable Specifications and Documentation; (b) it will comply with all laws applicable to its performance under this Agreement; and (c) the Software as delivered will be free of any virus, worm, time bomb, disabling device or other malicious code. If any Software, Deliverable or Service fails to conform to the warranties in this Section 12, Garman shall promptly repair, replace or re-perform the non-conforming item at no charge to Sparkling and, if Garman fails to do so within thirty (30) days of written notice, Garman shall refund the fees paid for the non-conforming Software, Deliverable or Service.
